got.summary: Caller Michael Campbell (DOB: February 5 1970) successfully rescheduled their CT Chest appointment from October 15th at 10:00 AM to Wednesday, October 14th at 10:00 AM at the Lakeshore Imaging Centre.

Caller Yan Zhang inquired about rescheduling an abdominal ultrasound appointment at Northgate Imaging Centre originally set for October 16. After being presented with alternative slots on October 13, the caller declined to reschedule and kept the original appointment.
Patient Jack Young called to reschedule their scan, but ultimately chose to keep their original appointment on Wednesday, October 14 at 11:00 AM.
Caller Nathan Anderson successfully cancelled their scheduled CT Head appointment for Thursday, October 15th at 2:00 PM.
Caller Ming Zhou successfully cancelled their MRI Knee appointment scheduled for Saturday, October 17th at 10:00 AM. No reason was provided for the cancellation.
Caller Juliette Juliette Fortin requested to cancel her thyroid ultrasound appointment scheduled for Thursday, October 15 at 1:00 PM. The cancellation was processed successfully.
Simran Gill called to confirm their Chest X-ray appointment at Midtown Imaging Centre scheduled for Wednesday, October 14th at 9:00 AM. The appointment was successfully confirmed.
Caller called to check and confirm their abdominal/pelvic CT scan appointment scheduled for Friday, October 16 at 15:00 at Lakeshore Imaging Centre.

Jack Ross called to confirm their MRI Lumbar Spine appointment scheduled for Monday, October 19 at 11:00 AM. The appointment cannot be confirmed yet because a safety screening requires a staff review. Staff will call the patient to complete this.

Patient Zoe called to inquire about preparation instructions for her CT Chest scan. She was advised to drink plenty of water the day before, arrive 30 minutes early, and inform staff of any kidney issues, diabetes medications, or past contrast dye reactions.

Caller Ling Yang inquired about the preparation instructions for their upcoming imaging exam. The agent advised drinking 1 liter of water one hour before the appointment and holding urine to keep the bladder full.
Patient Mathieu Lavoie called to ask how to prepare for his brain MRI. The assistant advised him to remove metal objects, declare if he has a pacemaker or implant, and arrive 15 minutes early.

The caller inquired about the Lakeshore clinic's location, hours of operation, and parking availability. The agent provided the address, operating hours, and details about the free underground parking. No further actions were requested.
The caller inquired about the address and operating hours of the Northgate clinic. The agent provided the clinic's address, hours, and parking information. No further action is required.
Caller Emma Emma Brown inquired if contrast dye is dangerous for her kidneys. The automated assistant transferred the call to a staff member to address her medical question.
The caller asked if their exam results were ready and expressed concern about cancer. The call was transferred to a human agent.
A caller attempted to check their appointment, but the automated assistant could not verify their identity (Grace Brown, DOB April 7 1944) and initiated a transfer to a staff member.
The caller, Lin Huang (1992年1月20日), failed automated identity verification multiple times and was transferred to a human representative for assistance.
The caller asked to speak to a real person and was transferred to the front desk.
Caller Sarah Wright called to cancel an appointment, but no upcoming appointments were found on file. She declined a transfer to a staff member.
